title: The Crystal Palace
question: How many people visited the Great Exhibition of 1851?

meanings.usage: 用于描述不寻常、令人惊叹的事物
指公开展出物品供人参观的活动
指经济活动中获得的利益
修饰可数名词，表示多样性
作名词时指展示；作动词时指展示或显示
指用交通工具运输人或物
表示从一边到另一边的动作
指将某物从一地移到另一地

meanings.meaning: 燃烧（burn的过去式/过去分词）

meanings.usage: 用于形容令人愉悦或惊叹的事物

examples.en: The Crystal Palace was made of iron and glass.
examples.zh: 水晶宫由铁和玻璃建成。

phrases.usage: 许多；大量（修饰可数名词）

examples.en: A great many goods were sent to the exhibition.
examples.zh: 大量商品被送往展览会展出。

examples.en: There were six million visitors in all.
examples.zh: 总共有六百万参观者。

examples.en: Steam boats carried thousands of visitors across the Channel.
examples.zh: 汽船把成千上万的游客运送过英吉利海峡。

examples.en: On arriving in England, they were taken to the Crystal Palace.
examples.zh: 一到英国，他们就被带到水晶宫。

examples.en: The profits were used to build museums and colleges.
examples.zh: 展览的利润用来建造博物馆和学院。

examples.en: It was burnt down in 1936.
examples.zh: 它在1936年被烧毁。

examples.en: The Crystal Palace was different from all other buildings.
examples.zh: 水晶宫不同于所有其他建筑。

phrases.usage: 大量；许多（修饰不可数名词）

examples.en: There was also a great deal of machinery on display.
examples.zh: 还有大量机器展出。

examples.en: travelling was not as easy as it is today
examples.zh: 旅行不像今天这样方便

sentences.en: Perhaps the most extraordinary building of the nineteenth century was the Crystal Palace
sentences.zh: 19世纪最不同寻常的建筑，或许就是水晶宫了，

sentences.en: which was built in Hyde Park for the Great Exhibition of 1851.
sentences.zh: 它是为1851年的万国博览会在海德公园建造的。

sentences.en: The Crystal Palace was different from all other buildings in the world, for it was made of iron and glass.
sentences.zh: 水晶宫与世界上所有其他建筑都不同，因为它是由钢铁和玻璃建造的。

sentences.en: It was one of the biggest buildings of all time and a lot of people from many countries came to see it.
sentences.zh: 它是迄今为止最大的建筑之一，许多国家的人们都前来参观。

sentences.en: A great many goods were sent to the exhibition from various parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 许多商品从世界各地运到博览会展出。

sentences.en: There was also a great deal of machinery on display.
The most wonderful piece of machinery on show was Nasmyth's steam hammer.
sentences.zh: 展出的最精彩的机器是纳史密斯蒸汽锤。

sentences.en: Though in those days travelling was not as easy as it is today,
sentences.zh: 尽管在那些日子里旅行不像今天这样容易，

sentences.en: steam boats carried thousands of visitors across the Channel from Europe.
sentences.zh: 汽船还是载着成千上万的游客从欧洲渡过英吉利海峡。

sentences.en: On arriving in England, they were, taken to the Crystal Palace by train.
sentences.zh: 抵达英国后，他们乘火车前往水晶宫。

sentences.en: There were six million visitors in all,
and the profits from the exhibition were used to build museums and colleges.
sentences.zh: 博览会的利润被用于建造博物馆和学院。

sentences.en: Later, the Crystal Palace was moved to South London.
sentences.zh: 后来，水晶宫被搬到了伦敦南部。

sentences.en: It remained one of the most famous buildings in the world until it was burnt down in 1936.
sentences.zh: 它一直是世界上最著名的建筑之一，直到1936年被烧毁。

grammar.title: 被动语态（一般过去时）
grammar.definition: 表示主语是动作的承受者，谓语用be+过去分词形式
grammar.structure: 主语 + was/were + 过去分词 + (by + 施动者)
grammar.usage: 当强调动作承受者或不知道动作执行者时使用被动语态

examples.en: The Crystal Palace was built in Hyde Park.
examples.zh: 水晶宫建在海德公园。

examples.en: A great many goods were sent to the exhibition.
examples.zh: 大量商品被送往展览会。

examples.en: They were taken to the Crystal Palace by train.
examples.zh: 他们乘火车被带到水晶宫。

grammar.title: 让步状语从句
grammar.definition: 表示虽然/尽管某种相反的情况存在
grammar.structure: Though/Although + 主语 + 动词，主句
grammar.usage: 用来引出让步或对比的情况

examples.en: Though in those days travelling was not as easy as it is today, steam boats carried thousands of visitors.
examples.zh: 虽然那时候旅行不像今天这样方便，汽船还是运送了成千上万的游客。

grammar.title: There be 句型的过去时
grammar.definition: 表示过去某地存在某人或某物
grammar.structure: There was/were + 主语 + 地点/时间

examples.en: There was also a great deal of machinery on display.
examples.zh: 还有大量机器展出。

examples.en: There were six million visitors in all.
examples.zh: 总共有六百万参观者。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 过去分词 + 地点/时间

original.en: The Crystal Palace was built in Hyde Park for the Great Exhibition of 1851.
original.zh: 水晶宫建在海德公园，用于1851年的世博会。

examples.en: The museum was built in 1990.
examples.zh: 这座博物馆建于1990年。

examples.en: Many schools were built in this area.
examples.zh: 这个地区建了很多学校。

patterns.pattern: There were/was + 数量 + 主语 + in all

original.en: There were six million visitors in all.

examples.en: There were 500 students in this school in all.
examples.zh: 这所学校总共有500名学生。

examples.en: There was a lot of food in the restaurant.
examples.zh: 餐厅里有很多食物。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + was/were + used to + 动词原形

original.en: The profits were used to build museums and colleges.
original.zh: 展览的利润用来建造博物馆和学院。

examples.en: The money was used to help the poor.
examples.zh: 这笔钱用来帮助穷人。

examples.en: This room is used to hold meetings.
examples.zh: 这个房间用来开会。

patterns.pattern: Though + 主语 + 动词, 主语 + 动词

original.en: Though in those days travelling was not as easy as it is today, steam boats carried thousands of visitors across the Channel.
original.zh: 虽然那时候旅行不像今天这样方便，汽船还是运送了成千上万的游客穿过英吉利海峡。

examples.en: Though it was raining, we still went out.
examples.zh: 虽然下雨了，我们还是出去了。

examples.en: Though she was tired, she continued working.
examples.zh: 虽然她累了，她继续工作。
